title: Whitehead — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Whitehead's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* The page's claim that the grain is the actual occasion and the cloud the society.

pieces.file: Whitehead — rich — one occasion, then the society — picture.svg
pieces.title: One occasion, then the society · drawn
pieces.caption: One grain, alone. It arises and is gone. Again. Then they arrive faster, until near twelve seconds you stop hearing grains and hear a tone. Nothing in that tone persists: no grain lasts a tenth of a second. The tone is the pattern they hold together.
pieces.near: the grain is the actual occasion

verdicts.why: Faithful and worth having: the page says "A typed link is a prehension" and the ring makes that visible with Whitehead's own neighbours; legible at margin width. But two stated counts are off by one: the page declares 7 links, not 6. The seventh, `mirrors` → STIGMERGY v1.0 — Palace Front-End, is a bundle file outside the map, and the page gives it a whole section.
